text: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: It offers students a most pertinent and unique combination of subjects, addressing contemporary Chinese business concerns, Chinese culture, Asian values and advanced Western and American business practice and management. International business introduces students to the world of global business. Courses cover the basics of the global economy, cultural influences on business, the impact of government decisions on business, what form of business to choose, importing and exporting goods and services, foreign exchange, and international management topics. 2. Core Courses Editor Notes: Courses may change every year, so the courses listed below are only for reference. International Business, Strategic Management, International Business Negotiation, Entrepreneurship, Mathematics for Business, Human Resource Management, Chinese Culture & Business Etiquette, International Trade. 3. Program Characteristics Editor Notes: You can known more about this program from the following characteristics. 1. An internationalized curriculum coupled with Chinese studies (Chinese language, culture, economics, business, laws and social studies) 2. An international faculty and internationally experienced Chinese professors who offer both the international and Chinese perspectives on contemporary business issues 3. Immersion Week: visits to Fortune 500 companies and top Chinese companies every semester 4. Internships and employment opportunities in multinational companies and organizations in China 5. Diversity in student composition: students from over 80 countries are empowered to develop cross-cultural communication skills in everyday life 6. Full integration with Chinese students, providing an opportunity to network with the top Chinese students 7. Home-Stay opportunities and Extended Family experience: Live with local Chinese families and immerse yourself in real Chinese community 8. Scholarship available for excellent students. 4. Introduction of International Business School Editor Notes: IBS is committed to be a first-class international business school to cultivate business elites with best foreign language and cross-cultural capabilities in China. The International Business School (IBS) is one of the youngest and most vigorous schools of Beijing Foreign Studies University (BFSU). In keeping with the international vision of BFSU, IBS has launched English-based programs for international students. Its mission is to offer students a highly enriching and rewarding multi-disciplinary learning experience with its excellent business-related courses and professional Chinese language teaching, thus helping ensure its students' success as future managers and executives in the global economy. Our graduates are well versed in the latest business management theory and practice. They are prepared to be responsible business leaders of the 21st Century with a specialized focus on the emerging and challenging business issues as China continues to become an important economic partner for many developed economies.
